info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Update Operational Service By Reward Id-spec
info.description: This API allows you to update specific operational services associated with a given reward ID. By using this endpoint, businesses can modify the details of the operational services to reflect changes or improvements. Typical users include developers and system integrators who manage operational workflows or require updates based on user feedback or organizational changes. The endpoint ensures that operational data stays current and relevant, facilitating better service management and user experience.

patch.summary: Update the rewards information for a specific resource.
patch.description: This endpoint allows you to update the details of the rewards associated with the specified resource identifier. Ensure that you provide the necessary fields in the request body to successfully update the rewards information. This operation is essential for maintaining up-to-date reward data.
